sentences.text: Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case and he has not committed any offence as claimed by the prosecution.

Learned counsel for the applicant while referring to the F.I.R. placed at page no.53 of the paper book, which has been lodged by the concerned Supply Inspector at Police Station Noida, Gautam Budhanagar Commissionerate on 30.08.2018, submits that in the instant F.I.R. allegations have been levelled against the named accused persons including the applicant to have manipulated the data base of the eligible persons and by manipulating the same, the food-grains and other items,
which were meant to be distributed to the eligible persons, have been misappropriated, however,
after lodging of this F.I.R. the applicant along with two other accused persons had approached this Court (High Court at Allahabad) by filing Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 2517 of 2018 and vide order dated 11.09.2018 considering that the applicants are ladies, the Division Bench of this Court provided protection till the submission of police report under Section 173(2) Cr.P.C.

entities.text: Police Station Noida, Gautam Budhanagar Commissionerate
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: While referring to the F.I.R. of the instant case i.e. namely Case Crime No. 007 of 2018, registered at Police Station Cyber Crime, Lucknow against three named persons, it is vehemently submitted that on the basis of same allegations pertaining to which earlier F.I.R. was lodged, this second F.I.R. has been lodged with regard to the modus operandi adopted by the accused persons in manipulating the data base of the eligible persons and it is during the course of the investigation on the statement of one Pushpendra Pal, the name of the applicant had surfaced to the tune that he had contacted him for the purpose of manipulating the data base of their respective fair price shops in order to misappropriate the food-grains and other necessary items.

It is also submitted that identically placed co-accused persons have been granted anticipatory bail by the subordinate court as well as co-accused persons namely Jitendra @ Jitendra Kumar Gupta,
Babita and Geeta Chaudhari have also been granted anticipatory bail by Coordinate Bench of this Court, vide order dated 02.03.2023 and 06.04.2023 passed in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/s 438 Cr.P.C. No. 586 of 2023, 792 of 2023 and 823 of 2023, respectively.
It is also submitted that apart from the instant case and the earlier case the applicant is not involved any other criminal case.

He undertakes that he will remain present before the investigating officer whenever his presence would be required and shall also abide by any condition imposed by this Court as well as trial court, thus protection from arrest be granted to him.
Learned A.G.A. on the other hand submits that the applicant is not cooperating with the investigating officer therefore, he is not entitled for any protection.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that earlier an F.I.R. was lodged against the applicant and other accused persons pertaining to manipulation made by them in the data base of the eligible persons registered for distribution of food-grains and Jeet Singh vs State Of U.P. opennyai_summary.decision:
Let counter affidavit/objections by the State be filed within two weeks from today.
List this case on 24.04.2023.
It is provided that till the next date of listing in the event of arrest of the applicant- Jeet Singh involved in the above noted case, he shall be released on anticipatory bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs. 30,000/- with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer of the Police Station concerned/ Investigating Officer subject to the following conditions:
(1) The applicant shall appear before the investigating officer as and when required and in this regard shall appear before the investigation or in his absence before the S.H.O. concerned and shall provide his mobile number on which he may be contacted.
(2) The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation or for discovery of any fact by a police officer as and when required;
(3) The applicant shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer;
(4) The applicant shall not leave the District concerned without the previous permission of the Court.?
4. Although a counter affidavit has been filed in connected application, nothing has come to light which may persuade this Court to take a view, different from the view taken while passing the aforesaid order, nor the learned A.G.A. has pointed out violation of any of the conditions of interim anticipatory bail committed by the applicant.
In view of the aforesaid circumstances, the interim order dated 10.04.2023 is hereby made absolute and the application is allowed in terms of the aforesaid order.
6. In case, the applicant has not furnished bail bonds, he shall appear before the trial court and submit bail bonds within a period of two weeks from today.
